dedupe_keys.name: schematique des collecteurs de drainage agricole

description: Schématique des collecteurs de drainage agricole is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. En corrélation avec le plan des périmètres drainés, le plan schématique des collecteurs permet de situer géographiquement l'écoulement des périmètres drainés ainsi que leurs exutoires. Ce réseau de collecteurs recense environ 800 km de tuyaux de diamètres variant de 80 à 1000 mm. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
